steps.name: design-review
steps.summary: phases/9-polish/REVIEW.md: 23-item punch list (no P0; kiosk K1-K10 for step 1, phone/demo/landing X1-X13 for step 2) from qa:ui (25 passed, 0 H; QA_ALL=1 12 specs fail on known T misses only, output in qa-output/) and J1-J3 walks. Top 5: X1 the phone talk footer covers [Yes, pay now] on P4 at 360x800/320x700 and on /demo confirm (rail 1440x900 hidden, R-009, I-134); K1 the K3 'AI가 담았어요' pill and KX staff banner cover the highlighted tile and rail (I-045); K2/K3 /demo kiosk shows a stuck Korean '터치 0번 · 0초' counter (I-135, I-113) and a [다른 휴대폰 연결] that voids the demo's phone (I-066); X3 phone chrome too tall (header wraps at <=360, ~200px footer, action strip leaves the /demo cart one line, I-084); X4 landing hero capture text ~7px, nothing readable shows the product (I-136). Also K4 rail tile shows the child fare 'from' (I-119). New ISSUE rows I-134..I-138; orchestrator's '11px kiosk text' is ~17px (kiosk height-bound at 466px), D1 right half is no longer empty. No product code changed.

Fixed: K4/I-119 tiles show tilePrice (default options = adult fare, no 'from'), K4 discount groups show full fares; K1/I-045 AI status takes the toolbar row for 2 s (row controls invisible), staff/paused banners are an in-flow strip at the top (screen roots flex-1); K2+K3/I-135,I-113,I-066 /demo passes no `demo` and no onClaimUrl, so no tap counter and no [Connect another phone] (KioskScreen.demo now = &demo=1 only; useDemoSession.setClaimUrl removed); K5/I-048 partial: K2 has KioskToolbar (small QR) and larger dine photos, [처음으로] still needs a decision; K6/I-101 /demo learned widget is a strip under the page (LearnedKioskHost strip), I-096 page text unchanged; K7/I-109 K4 option names keep bracketed ranges unbroken (KeepRange), rail '교통카드·/이용권' break accepted; K8/I-120 K4 variant buttons capitalized; K10/I-041 k-text-40/48 line height 1.5, I-042 only K2 pt-16, 40px spacing left open. Not done: K9/I-039 (user decision). Docs: ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY, UX screen map. steps.name: polish-phone

I-039 decided won't do (delete and re-add; fair touch measurement in step 3). Fixed: X1/I-134 P4 bottom area = total + 88px [Yes, pay now] + compact mic with [Type] (text input on demand or after voice fallback), toBeInViewport({ratio:1}) at all 4 phone sizes and the /demo confirm states; X2/I-132 scenario guide open by default >=1440; X3/I-084 phone header one row at every width (globe-only language <400px, stacked Call staff), mic basis 10rem so AI voice shares the row at 320, 'What the AI did' moves into the guide column >=1440 (stays through the review there); X4/I-136 shots:landing crops /demo to kiosk+phone at 2x (1280x1168) shown full width under a headline+buttons row on /, one region per How-it-works step, all landing/D1 captures recaptured with the new fares; X5/I-123 partial (one-line titles 'Pizza shop', full-width Start; persona lines still uneven, pizza capture unchanged); X6/I-116 phone ticket wording via pt(key, locale, domain); X7/I-118+I-069 P5 'On the kiosk, tap 카드 (Card), then insert your card.', stand-in 'Insert the card at the kiosk', picture mirrored in /demo; X8/I-133 shorter ticket placeholder; X9/I-103 learned kiosk: no photo slot on dine buttons and cart lines; X10/I-137 phone prices use formatWon; X11/I-131 'Your turn' scrolls into view; X12/I-138+I-121 QA screenshots wait for on-screen images, focus check blurs its last control; X13/I-074 /demo below 900px shows 'Open this on a laptop' + /kiosk link. Remaining: I-123 card second lines/pizza capture, I-073 learned end card below the fold. Docs: UX (C2a, C2b, C4, K2, K3, P4, D2), UI_QA, ISSUE. Lint, build, 707 unit, e2e 14 passed (15 @live skipped), qa:ui 25 passed; evidence/*.json restored after e2e (I-099).

steps.name: compare-card
steps.summary: Fair touch run: e2e/kiosk-touch-efficient.spec.ts (fries L picked in the sheet, no clear-all, dessert declined, own X-Forwarded-For 192.0.2.38) = 24 taps, same 14,800원 cart, saved with its cart ids to evidence/touch-hero-efficient.json (written only when missing or EVIDENCE=1, I-099); 41-tap edit path kept as footnote. D3 Touch vs talk card on /demo?k=malo after paid (src/components/demo/CompareCard.tsx, above DemoEndCard via `compare` prop): live counts from DemoApp (messages via new AssistantPanel onUserTurn / useChat onSend incl. voice turns; phone and kiosk taps via pointerdown on enabled buttons in each half; seconds from Start/Try again to the server's paidAt minus clockOffset; counts bound to the new session, frozen at paid). Touch column from src/lib/demo/evidence.ts (Turbopack import.meta.glob, bundled at build time, missing file hides it): human-runs.json medians preferred, else automated taps only, its time deliberately 'Not shown: an automated run taps at machine speed'; 'The same order by touch' only when sameOrder(cart, HERO_CART), else 'The reference order' spelled out from menu data; no ratios. src/lib/demo/compare.ts (HERO_CART, sameOrder, median, zod parsers, buildComparison) with 12 unit tests; e2e/demo-compare.spec.ts (API-driven hero order via a routed /api/chat, 192.0.2.37) checks both columns against the evidence files. scripts/measure-touch.md + evidence/human-runs.template.json for 3+3 human runs. addCheeseburgerSet moved to e2e/helpers.ts. Docs: TESTING (measurements, ledger rows efficient/edit/human), README evidence row, UX C5 and D3, ISSUE I-039, I-099, I-068 (+1 own R-005 slip). Lint, build, 718 unit, e2e 16 passed (15 @live skipped), qa:ui 25 passed; evidence restored after e2e.

steps.name: cost-measure
steps.summary: Tokens per MALO hero order (4 turns: order, fries large, no dessert, I'll pay), 3 runs each, in evidence/cost-per-order.json (counts only, prices null 'fill from the official pricing page'). Text (gemini-3.8-flash, low, API key via .env I-125): median 90,393 tokens/order, 9 calls, prompt 89,696 (7,585 cached), output 367, thoughts 292, hero cart 3/3 (all ended paying: the AI opened the review on 'No, thanks' and its confirm on 'I'll pay' was accepted by the server rules). Voice (gemini-3.8-live, Live from Node with the token's config via new liveConnectConfig() in src/lib/agent/live.ts; turns 1-2 TTS fixtures, 3-4 typed): median 91,795 tokens/order (prompt 91,217, ~4,900 audio, 0 cached; output 578; thoughts 700 not in Live's total), ~34 s, hero cart 2/3; 1 of 4 attempts stalled on turn 1 (kept as failedAttempts, I-139). Code: tokenUsage() + ModelClient usage field in src/lib/agent/model.ts (tested), scripts/measure-cost.ts, npm run measure:cost. Live usage arrives with each generation's turnComplete; a turn ends at the first turnComplete without a tool call. Docs: TESTING Measurements + ledger row, ISSUE I-139. Lint, build, 720 unit passed, measure:cost ran.

steps.name: mic-test
steps.summary: I-128 fixed first: geminiTokenIssuer refuses a missing GEMINI_API_KEY before building the client; live.test.ts stubs fetch and asserts it is never called (model/health 'no key' tests already stop before a client exists). /mic-test (src/app/mic-test/page.tsx + MicTest.tsx; noindex, not linked): browser label + in-app name (browserInfo/inAppName in src/lib/phone/inApp.ts; iOS in-app = 'WebKit', desktop = family only), https, AudioWorklet; [Test microphone] with permission before/after (navigator.permissions, 'unknown' where unsupported), the voice's getUserMedia constraints and public/audio/pcm-recorder-worklet.js, live dB level meter (role=meter), context and track sample rates, peak; [Test speaker] = 600 ms 440 Hz tone through int16ToBase64 -> base64ToFloat32 -> 24 kHz buffer, reports AudioContext state after the tap and whether it ended; reload check via one sessionStorage flag (remembered / not remembered / unknown); copyable one-line summary. Pure helpers in src/lib/voice/micTest.ts (micLevel, tonePcm, reloadVerdict, browserLabel, summaryLine). Tests: inApp.test.ts browserInfo for KakaoTalk, NAVER, Instagram (+FBAN), Facebook, LINE, Safari, Chrome iOS/Android, Samsung; micTest.test.ts; e2e/mic-test.spec.ts (fake media flags: meter moves, speaker runs, result line, reload verdict, zero non-GET or /api requests; KakaoTalk UA named); e2e/qa/mic-test.qa.spec.ts at 4 phone sizes, 0 H 0 T. Docs: ISSUE I-128, TESTING iOS checks, UI_QA. Lint, build, 738 unit, e2e 19 passed (14 @live skipped); evidence/*.json restored after e2e (I-099). phases/9-polish/qa/ui-qa.jsonl was reset by the single QA spec run and is not committed; step 6's qa:ui regenerates it.
